patch_description: Use one collective RY parameter per repeated block and fixed nearest-neighbor CZ entanglers. This removes the redundant collective RZ layer, reducing the model from 14 to 8 total trainable parameters while retaining the previously observed perfect train, validation, and test accuracy. The real-valued mixer directly changes the fixed Z-Z observables, while CZ layers convert later collective rotations into correlated transformations. This also improves convergence and reduces circuit depth and gate count.
